tvShow.name: LINK CLICK
tvShow.overview: Using superpowers to enter their clientele’s photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at “Time Photo Studio,” a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis. Each job can be full of danger, but nothing is more important than fulfilling every order, no matter the scale…or peril involved!

episodes.name: Marrying by Contesting
episodes.overview: In order to marry Ouyang, the daughter of the master of martial arts, Siwen commissioned the Time Photo Studio to help him crack the master's unique martial arts.

episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi has started humming a song he got stuck in his head, and Lu Guang loses sleep because of it.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 2: About Ordering Takeout

episodes.overview: The trio come up with names for their new cat.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 9: Qiao Ling's Troubles

episodes.overview: Liu Siwen teaches the trio how to do stretches and splits at the dojo.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 12: Mid-autumn Full Moon
episodes.overview: A mooncake shopkeeper hires the Time Photo Studio to deliver a message to his mother.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 13: Birthday Surprise
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling prepare a surprise birthday party for Lu Guang.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 14: Halloween Horror
episodes.overview: Lu Guang gets frightened on Halloween night.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 15: About Computer Repair
episodes.overview: Lu Guang struggles to figure out why his laptop has suddenly stopped working.

episodes.name: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 16: The Second Round of Live Q&A!
episodes.overview: The trio host another Q&A live stream and answer more fan questions, with a surprise mystery box.

episodes.overview: A very special guest visits the Time Photo Studio.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 1 - Rehabilitation Training
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi is bored While recovering from an injury, so he has Lu Guang and Qiao Ling take care of his needs.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 2 - In Dreams and In Reality
episodes.overview: Lu Guang has a series of dreams while taking care of Cheng Xiaoshi.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 3 -  A Leisurely Day
episodes.overview: Liu Xiao is invited to Xia Fei's graduation ceremony. Vein tags along undercover, but not before giving Liu Xiao's pet owl some extra treats.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 4 - Party A and Party B
episodes.overview: Xia Fei reluctantly visits Liu Xiao after receiving a strange part-time job offer.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 5 -  The Occult Girl
episodes.overview: Qiao Ling figures out a new way to bring in new customers to the Time Photo Studio by using tarot cards.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 6 -  Surprise Live Stream
episodes.overview: Xia Fei hosts a special unboxing event livestream for some collaboration blind boxes.

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 7 - Distinguished Guest
episodes.overview: Li Haoling returns to the Time Photo Studio to answer some questions about the upcoming third season of "Time Angst-Man".

episodes.name: Mini Link Click Episode 8 - The Hour Hand Flees
episodes.overview: Qiao Ling gathers everyone to prepare for the annual anniversary music project, "Dream Out!".

episodes.name: Emma
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang accept a job requiring them to uncover financial information hidden in a photograph. Entering the past through the body of overworked employee Emma, Cheng must follow Lu Guang’s instructions and avoid altering events, but experiencing her loneliness and family struggles makes remaining detached increasingly difficult.

episodes.name: Secret Recipe
episodes.overview: Restaurant owner Yu Xia hires Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to recover a secret recipe kept by Lin Zhen, her former friend and business partner. With few useful clues available, Cheng dives into an old photograph and witnesses the history behind their successful restaurant, uncovering a deeply personal conflict beneath their bitter separation.

episodes.name: To Lose, Not To Win
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi enters a photograph from client Chen Xiao’s high-school days to deliver words he never shared with his basketball teammates. When an accident forces him into a crucial match that could determine the club’s future, Cheng must resist his competitive instincts and obey Lu Guang’s strict instruction: lose the game, no matter what.

episodes.name: Confess
episodes.overview: After accidentally changing the outcome of Chen Xiao’s basketball game, Cheng Xiaoshi continues delivering his client’s long-unspoken messages to friends and family. As the mission proceeds almost too smoothly, a troubling realization about the date reveals that something far more serious is approaching.

episodes.name: Farewell
episodes.overview: Knowing that a devastating earthquake is approaching, Cheng Xiaoshi desperately tries to warn Chen Xiao’s friends and the surrounding villagers, but no one believes him. Refusing to give up, he asks Lu Guang to help save Chen Xiao’s mother as the two confront the painful limits of changing the past.

episodes.name: Search of the Child
episodes.overview: A desperate father asks the Time Photo Studio to investigate the disappearance of his young son, Doudou, who vanished three years earlier. Despite the emotional toll of his previous mission, Cheng Xiaoshi enters surveillance footage from the day of the abduction and attempts to trace the child without disturbing the past.

episodes.name: Aunt May
episodes.overview: After losing sight of Doudou during their first attempt, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang discover a photograph taken by the child on the day he vanished. Entering Doudou’s body, Cheng experiences the abduction firsthand and must identify the kidnapper and uncover his location before the twelve-hour limit expires.

episodes.name: Lost Signal
episodes.overview: Xu Shanshan asks the studio to recover what her longtime friend Dong Yi told her during a drunken university gathering. While reliving the night through her photograph, Cheng Xiaoshi notices something unsettling and becomes distracted from the original assignment, drawing him into a mystery that may be more dangerous than it first appears.

episodes.name: Consequence of Goodwill
episodes.overview: After a disturbing call from Xu Shanshan’s phone leaves her unreachable, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Qiao Ling fear she may be in danger. While Lu Guang seeks help from the police, Cheng discovers a photograph connected to the case and impulsively dives into it alone, hoping to uncover the truth before it is too late.

episodes.name: Trap
episodes.overview: With Xu Shanshan still missing, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Qiao Ling begin searching for clues on their own. When a photograph connected to her disappearance offers a possible lead, Cheng ignores Lu Guang’s warning and enters the image, determined to uncover what happened before the situation grows even more dangerous.

episodes.name: Pinnacle of Light
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi puts a dangerous plan into motion to expose the person threatening those around the studio. As the confrontation unfolds, Emma’s unresolved fate continues to haunt him, leading him back into the past for one final attempt to reach her—while an unseen danger remains closer than anyone realizes.

seasons.name: Link Click
seasons.overview: At Time Photo Studio, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang use their complementary powers to enter photographs and fulfil their clients’ unresolved requests. Each mission draws them into lives shaped by regret, loss and difficult choices, while Cheng’s compassion repeatedly tests the rule against changing the past. When their cases become connected to a dangerous mystery, the consequences reach the studio itself.

episodes.name: Falling
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi returns to the photo studio to find Lu Guang critically wounded and Qiao Ling under the control of a mysterious enemy. Desperate to save them both, he tries to discover how to break the possession, but the arrival of the police leaves him detained as the investigation takes a troubling new direction.

episodes.name: Night Raid
episodes.overview: As Cheng Xiaoshi and the others investigate the mysterious enemy’s connection to photographs, Officer Chen Bin suddenly disappears along with a crucial piece of evidence. Meanwhile, Qian Jin pays an unexpected visit to Chen Bin’s home, while a coordinated nighttime assault places Lu Guang and those guarding him in immediate danger.

episodes.name: Two Funerals
episodes.overview: Following the hospital attack, Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling struggle with its emotional aftermath while Captain Xiao faces growing pressure surrounding the investigation. As two funerals bring grief, suspicion and unresolved questions to the surface, Cheng considers using his abilities to offer comfort to those left behind.

episodes.name: Them In The Photo
episodes.overview: As Captain Xiao reveals a troubling incident from Qian Jin’s past, the group learns that a mysterious visitor left Lu Guang a photograph bearing a cryptic message. Hoping it will provide clues about their enemy, Cheng Xiaoshi enters the image and finds himself experiencing the unfamiliar life of a young girl.

episodes.name: Last Supper
episodes.overview: While exploring the photograph left behind for the group, Cheng Xiaoshi experiences the difficult childhood of two siblings and searches their family life for clues. As tensions build around an evening meal, he struggles to remain detached from events that may hold the key to the mystery unfolding in the present.

episodes.name: Li Tianxi
episodes.overview: After witnessing the twins’ traumatic childhood, Cheng Xiaoshi is abruptly pulled out of the photograph and returns to the present. At the police station, he meets a mysterious witness connected to the investigation, hoping their conversation will clarify the growing threat surrounding the studio and reveal what truly happened to Li Tianxi.

episodes.name: Urban Warfare
episodes.overview: When Li Tianxi takes Cheng Xiaoshi from the police station, Captain Xiao and Qiao Ling race through the city to find him, only to be confronted by Qian Jin’s men. Meanwhile, Lu Guang disappears from his guarded hospital room, as the pursuit erupts into a dangerous battle across the streets.

episodes.name: Hostage
episodes.overview: Lu Guang’s unexpected intervention prevents Cheng Xiaoshi from being taken away, but the rescue places him in danger instead. As Cheng and the others regroup, Captain Xiao reveals new information connecting Qian Jin to the twins’ tragic past, giving their investigation an increasingly personal and dangerous direction.

episodes.name: Three Stories
episodes.overview: As Cheng Xiaoshi’s journey through the past continues, three interconnected stories reveal the events that brought Qian Jin and the Li twins together. Each account sheds new light on the tragedies and choices that shaped them, while Cheng faces a crucial decision that could change the course of the present.

episodes.name: Improvise
episodes.overview: After learning more about the twins’ abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and his allies devise a risky plan to rescue Lu Guang from Qian Jin and Li Tianchen. As both sides prepare for a hostage exchange, Cheng must adapt quickly when their carefully arranged strategy begins to unravel.

episodes.name: Confrontation
episodes.overview: During the tense hostage exchange, Cheng Xiaoshi’s carefully prepared rescue plan collides with Qian Jin’s countermeasures. Separated from his allies and drawn deeper into the theatre, Cheng faces a dangerous demand involving his powers and Qian Jin’s past, while the confrontation pushes everyone toward a decisive final clash.

episodes.name: Can't Live Without a Good Brother
episodes.overview: As the confrontation reaches its climax, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Captain Xiao fight to stop Qian Jin, while the Li twins face the consequences of their painful past. With loyalties shifting and unexpected powers entering the struggle, everyone must decide how far they will go to protect the person they cannot bear to lose.

seasons.name: Link Click 2
seasons.overview: Following the attack on Time Photo Studio, Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling become entangled in a dangerous investigation while Lu Guang fights to recover. As a mysterious enemy uses photographs to control others, the group uncovers a tragic family history and a conspiracy surrounding their powers, forcing them into a desperate struggle to protect one another and expose the mastermind behind the escalating violence.

episodes.name: So Time Begins to Flow Again
episodes.overview: Following a devastating attack, Lu Guang returns to the time when he first met Cheng Xiaoshi, determined to prevent the future he witnessed. As he relives the beginning of their friendship, a series of seemingly ordinary encounters begins setting their shared destiny in motion once again.

episodes.name: Prelude
episodes.overview: While Liu Xiao becomes trapped in a dangerous wager at a Bridon bar, Cheng Xiaoshi discovers a photograph apparently sent by his missing father. Believing it may provide a clue about his parents, he decides to travel to Bridon, despite Qiao Ling’s strong objections.

episodes.name: Them
episodes.overview: Following clues connected to Cheng Xiaoshi’s missing parents, he and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon and visit a bar popular with football supporters. There they meet the friendly Xia Fei, but an impulsive celebration provokes a rival group and draws the three into a dangerous chase through the city.

episodes.name: And Then There Were None
episodes.overview: After Xia Fei’s enigmatic boss, Vein, rescues the group from their pursuers, Lu Guang becomes suspicious of their new ally. Cheng Xiaoshi later returns to the bar seeking information about BAHATI, where he uncovers a connection to a language school destroyed in a devastating fire ten years earlier.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang search for anyone who survived the disaster. Their investigation leads Cheng into a photograph belonging to Wang Qing, a gifted student trapped in a difficult situation, where he uncovers a personal connection that may bring him closer to the truth about his father.

episodes.name: Puzzle
episodes.overview: To earn Vein’s help in locating Wang Qing, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang agree to replace a missing model at a photo shoot. Their unusual payment leads them to Wang Qing’s mental health clinic, where her psychological tests begin raising unsettling questions about the people and hidden motives surrounding their investigation.

seasons.name: Bridon Arc
seasons.overview: When a photograph connected to Cheng Xiaoshi’s missing parents is discovered, he and Lu Guang travel to Bridon in search of answers. Their investigation leads them into the aftermath of a devastating academy fire and the lives of several strangers hiding conflicting motives. As buried connections gradually emerge, Lu Guang quietly struggles against the fate he fears may be awaiting Cheng.

episodes.name: The Forgotten Past
episodes.overview: An adoptive father, an old photo, and the day two powers first crossed paths.

episodes.name: The Caged Beast
episodes.overview: Searching for Xia Fei means going where no one looks. That has never stopped Cheng Xiaoshi.

episodes.name: Bloodbath in Laos
episodes.overview: Faced with a crisis, can Cheng Xiaoshi save Xia Fei, or will help come from someone else?

episodes.name: Jae
episodes.overview: A mysterious visitor from Bridon disrupts the photo studio's peace. What has he come for?

episodes.name: Welcome Banquet
episodes.overview: Over a steaming hot pot feast, rival factions quietly begin to clash.

seasons.name: Link Click 3
seasons.overview: After the Li Tianchen incident came to an end, the Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial calm. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again plunged everyone into the crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening powers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case. Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seemed to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao, from a mysterious organization, begins his actions, and the intervention of Bridon police officer Jae adds uncertainty to this quest for the truth.
